library.description: PostgreSQL storage backend with native transactions and optional pgvector

blocks.text: 包根不加载任何客户端。适配入口分别引用真实 peer；逻辑复制还要求 Node 22+ 与 pg-logical-replication >=2.6.0 <3。Bun 1.4.3 在 I/O 前拒绝，因为缺少所需 COPY 与字段元数据。
`server` 缺省 `postgres`，另外支持按实际版本探测的 `cockroach`、`yugabyte`。只有 PostgreSQL 声明 changeFeed；Cockroach 不支持 pgvector Feature。兼容协议不等于经过真实服务验收：本次环境只有 PostgreSQL，另两项仍未验证。当前本机 Bun 为 1.4.3，因此 1.4.4+ 原生路径仍未验证。

items: `/features/pgvector`：`pgvectorFeature()` 发布标准 vector，另有 `api.pgvector.search(target, query, options)` 查询调用方自有表。未选不发布 vector；扩展经 registerDetect 检查。`autoDetect:false` 时仍在首次真实向量终点写前核对扩展。
`/features/listen`：`pgListenFeature()` 发布根 `api.notifications.listen/notify`；事务只有 notify。提示只在真实提交后出现，不保证断线重放。
`/features/copy`：`pgCopyFeature()` 发布根/事务 `api.copy.from`。只支持结构化目标与客户端 STDIN；每次实际尝试调用新的 sourceFactory，保留背压与原生排空。

`/features/logical-replication`：`pgLogicalReplicationFeature({slot,publication})` 发布 durableChangeFeed。部署方预建持久 pgoutput slot、FOR ALL TABLES publication 与 REPLICATION 权限；只支持 postgres preset 与 `/pg`。dispose 不删除 slot。

blocks.text: 向量为真实 `vector(d)`，默认使用数据库计划及已有 ANN 索引；`exact:true` 仅在当前读事务禁用 ANN。可忠实下推的 where、org、期限先过滤再 topK。函数条件只处理命中，不补搜；requirePushdown 在 I/O 前拒绝客户端条件。deleteWhere 三种 count 模式均使用 DELETE RETURNING 的实际数，包括物理仍存在的过期匹配点。

配置缺省 schema=`public`、prefix=`migaia`。kv/bytes/records/meta/revisions/locks/journal/commit_markers/vector_config 以及托管向量表均以 `(org_id,key)` 为主键，索引以 org_id 领先。记录使用 bytea 规范键，其它表为原规范字节的 hex TEXT；文本与记录使用原 portable/collections TEXT codec。payload 的 JSONB 仅为可下推投影。
锁和 TTL 使用数据库 clock_timestamp()。活值覆盖保留 TTL，过期删除保留修订墓碑。数组绑定实现批量接口；空批不建立事务或触发 pipeline/hooks。组织共表，同名键隔离；组织视图拒绝 raw SQL/COPY 自有表终点。
事务请求 READ COMMITTED，SHOW 报告实际级别。可信 40001/40P01 真正回滚后检查原修订：未变内部物理重放、不重入外层 pipeline、不调用策略、保留原锁行；变化才交原 WRITE_CONFLICT 策略。回调可能重放，外部副作用没有 exactly-once 保证。COMMIT 发送后的传输失败不自动重放，也不声称零写。
本包错误 source 为 `storage.backend.postgres`：SQL_FAILED、DECODE_FAILED、TRANSACTION_FAILED、DUPLICATE_KEY；共享准入、并发、取消、期限错误沿原契约常量。原错误保留在 cause 链。hooks 只观察，抛错或异步拒绝只报告；干预使用 host pipeline。
更多批量、原生 SQL、向量、COPY、复制场景见 USEGUIDE。

全局 `journal: { logger, namespace, binlogValues: true }` 可借用原 logger 的外置 binlog：本包在原事务内捕获 text/bytes/record/托管 vector 的实际改动和完整期限，真实 COMMIT 后才 append，并等待原 append 结算。外置 append 失败经宿主报告与 `onBinlogAppendError` 观察，不能撤回已经提交的数据；不承诺外置日志与数据原子提交。选用完整镜像时，原生 SQL/COPY/调用者向量表在业务查询或拉取 source 前拒绝。

PostgreSQL 的 storageLogStore 使用 indexExclusive:false，每操作在原生事务内读取当前日志，不保留跨操作索引。现有 journal 表主键通过 INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING 初始化缺失 head 行，随后 SELECT FOR UPDATE 在同一事务内串行读写；不增加表、资源期锁或续租器。nativeAtomic 与原 scope/terminal 保持，40001/40P01 仍走原物理重试。借用同一 logger 的外置 WAL 时，原共享 owner 先 await intent，再在同一 PG 事务写入独立命名的 commit marker；真实提交后 append/complete，失败保留 intent 与 marker，重开沿原 owner 恢复。此 marker 与 lost-COMMIT 短期证据复用同一私有表但身份不同，正常事务清理不会误删恢复证据。同一 logger 同时选择外置 WAL 与 undoLog 时，宿主才投影 `store.undo(txId, ctx?)`：原 builder 先锁定全部目标，复核完整修订与镜像，再在一个真实 PG 事务恢复 text/bytes/record/vector/metadata 与绝对期限；新提交仍进入原日志。metadata 的日志身份沿原 flat-key codec 往返，版本与私有键锁复用原 revisions/lock owner，ABA 即使值已恢复相同也拒绝。原修订行保存 native `birth` UUID 与递增 `version`；dropOrg 仍删除全部目标组织行，重建的新 birth 阻止旧 undo 复用同版本。已有私有修订表增列时保原值与版本，缺少 birth 的旧外置镜像以 `UNDO_CONFLICT` 安全拒绝。不同组织的日志不能互相恢复。选择 `level()` 的同一 logger 并设置 `telemetry: true` 时，原宿主观察器记录普通 payload、完整原错误、固定组织与规范键；原完整重试循环只发一条，scope 与私有 metadata 不重复记录。关闭该选项不读取 level 方法，日志失败只报告。
每次原生提交先写同事务 marker。COMMIT 应答丢失后仅在原 marker 可见时认定已提交；缺失或读取失败不证明零写，本包封闭原物理 controller，保留原错误链且不盲重放。正常结算后删除该 marker；清理失败只报告并保留证据。
选中日志时按执行顺序保留每次实际原生变更，包含同目标多写与中间值。原 SQL 的 RETURNING 行直接提供每次完整 raw 新值与绝对期限，不以后读的最终值替代。undo 仍由 host 原实现合并首次 before、最终 after 并复核完整最终修订；未选日志的操作保原 SQL 与原生路径。
先按 README 选择 `/pg`、`/postgres-js` 或 Bun 1.4.4+ 的 `/bun`，把调用方拥有的 driver 交给 postgresBackendPlugin。以下 `store` 均来自唯一宿主的 `host.backend('postgres')`；Feature 必须显式挂在同一插件上。
批量按输入序重建重复读取，重复写键在 I/O 前拒绝；所有数组各占一个参数，数据不插入 SQL。TTL=null 元素仅是内部数组载体，公开省略 ttlMs 表示覆盖活值保期限、新值无期限；0 为立即到期。每条时间更新使用数据库采样，不接收客户端绝对期限。

`host.org(validUuid).backend('postgres')` 固定组织，所有标准集合及同名键/期限/锁/通知隔离，组织首次使用不建表。标准 vector/durableChangeFeed 由所选 Feature 在原组织 provider 中发布；原生调用方表接口在组织视图拒绝。记录与原生应用表都可在默认 root 的同一个事务中修改，但 raw SQL 的租户过滤由调用方负责。

原生应用表的 JSONB、全文索引、FOR UPDATE、pg_advisory_xact_lock 直接使用 SQL，无附加包装 Feature。标准记录保 portable TEXT，字段查询使用共同 query owner 的客户端语义与原 bytea 键范围。int8 返回 bigint、numeric/date/JSON/array 返回原文本、bytea 返回复制 Uint8Array；不改全局 parser。postgres.js 绑定字符串时显式选 TEXT 类型，避免客户端按目标 OID 再 JSON 序列化；应用 SQL 需要其它类型时写显式 cast。

cosine、dot、euclid 使用原生 `<=>`、`<#>`、`<->`；score 分别为 1-distance、-distance、-distance。原生 vector(d) 使用 float32，容许相应数值精度与同分换序。先建一次逻辑集合，其它 org 可 `collection('documents')` 使用同一物理配置。`api.pgvector.search({table:['app_vectors'],idColumn:'id',vectorColumn:'embedding',payloadColumn:'payload'}, q, {metric:'cosine',limit:10,efSearch:64})` 只查询调用方已有表；本包不自动建立 ANN 索引。
全局集合配置使用原配置表中的稳定私有 namespace 身份，与各 host 的缺省组织无关；相同 schema/prefix/name 在不同 host 复用同一原生表。dropOrg 只删除目标组织的点行，保留全局配置、其它组织与原生表结构。期限索引同样以 org_id 领先。

目标表由应用预建；CSV 缺省 header=false、delimiter=','；text 缺省 TAB 且禁 header。只支持客户端 STDIN，不接受文件或 PROGRAM。sourceFactory 每次真实尝试重新创建，不能捕获已消费的单次流。失败会等真实 COPY 排空后回滚；tx 没有 listen。通知频道非空、UTF8 <=63 字节，载荷 <8000 字节，都拒绝 NUL。

部署方设置 wal_level=logical、REPLICATION 角色、持久 pgoutput slot 与 FOR ALL TABLES publication。包只探测，不执行部署 DDL。一个提交按 org 首次 WAL 顺序合并有界失效摘要，不保存业务行。cursor 不透明，包含 store/slot/组织路由、COMMIT 的 commitEndLsn 与已处理组织前缀。部分提交绝不确认该 end，恢复时从原 slot 未确认位置重解并跳过已处理前缀；末项才允许后续 after 或成功 tail 确认。peer 使用 auto:false、timeoutSeconds:0、flowControl:true，绝不确认 row LSN/commitLsn，也不加减1。只允许一个活跃 slot 消费者。

回调失败停止且不上报成功位置；dispose 只释放复制连接，不删 slot、不关 pool。首次空读返回绑定原 native confirmed 位置的完整 cursor；slot lost、已落后于 slot confirmed 的完整 cursor，或已确认到本提交 end 的部分 cursor，均报 CHANGE_CURSOR_EXPIRED，不跳过无法证明的缺口。启动中取消或 native ready 查询失败会拒绝并排空原复制资源。当前 root 的多组织 TRUNCATE 无法从 WAL 推导全部持久 org，安全停止该提交且不确认；组织视图可对自身宽失效。普通 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE 路径不受影响；该 TRUNCATE 边界待用户复核。

Install PostgreSQL through the single storage-host owner. Standard KV, bytes, records, TTL, counters, SQL, transactions, key locks and PostgreSQL invalidations share native connections and the existing contract owners. The caller owns its driver/client/pool: dispose the host first, then close the client.

blocks.text: The root loads no client. Each adapter references its real peer. Logical replication additionally requires Node 22+ and pg-logical-replication >=2.6.0 <3. Bun 1.4.3 rejects before I/O because required COPY and column metadata are absent.

`server` defaults to `postgres`; `cockroach` and `yugabyte` are admitted by actual version probes. Only PostgreSQL declares changeFeed; Cockroach rejects the pgvector Feature. Protocol compatibility is not runtime verification: this environment provides PostgreSQL only. Cockroach/Yugabyte remain unverified. Installed Bun is 1.4.3, so the 1.4.4+ native path remains unverified.

items: `/features/pgvector`: `pgvectorFeature()` publishes standard vector and `api.pgvector.search(target, query, options)` for caller-owned native tables. Unselected stores have no vector. registerDetect checks the extension; with autoDetect:false, the first actual vector endpoint still checks before writing.
`/features/listen`: `pgListenFeature()` provides root `api.notifications.listen/notify`; transactions expose notify only. Hints appear after real commit and do not promise reconnect replay.

`/features/copy`: `pgCopyFeature()` provides root/transaction `api.copy.from`. It accepts structured identifiers and client STDIN only. Each actual attempt invokes a fresh sourceFactory and retains native backpressure/drain.

`/features/logical-replication`: `pgLogicalReplicationFeature({slot,publication})` publishes durableChangeFeed. Deployment creates the persistent pgoutput slot, FOR ALL TABLES publication and REPLICATION permission. Only postgres with `/pg` supports it. Disposal never drops the slot.

blocks.text: Managed vectors use native `vector(d)`. The default uses the database plan and existing ANN indexes; exact:true disables ANN only in the current read transaction. Faithful where/org/expiry filters precede topK. Function conditions process hits without refill; requirePushdown rejects client conditions before I/O. All deleteWhere count modes return the actual DELETE RETURNING count, including physically present expired matches.

Defaults are schema=public and prefix=migaia. KV/bytes/records/meta/revisions/locks/journal/commit_markers/vector_config and managed vector tables use `(org_id,key)` primary keys with org-leading indexes. Records use canonical bytea keys; other tables use hex over the same canonical bytes. Text and records retain portable/collections TEXT codecs. Payload JSONB exists only as a pushdown projection.

Locks and TTL use database clock_timestamp(). Replacing a live value preserves TTL; expiry/deletion keeps revision tombstones. Batch methods bind arrays. Empty batches open no transaction and invoke no pipeline/hooks. Organizations share tables and isolate equal keys. Organization views reject raw SQL/COPY caller-table endpoints.

Transactions request READ COMMITTED and SHOW reports the actual level. Trusted 40001/40P01 failures roll back before revision comparison: unchanged baselines replay physically without reentering the outer pipeline, strategy decisions or releasing the original locks; changed baselines enter the original WRITE_CONFLICT strategy. Callbacks may replay; external effects have no exactly-once guarantee. A transport failure after COMMIT is sent never causes blind replay or a claim of zero writes.

Owned error source is storage.backend.postgres: SQL_FAILED, DECODE_FAILED, TRANSACTION_FAILED and DUPLICATE_KEY. Shared admission/concurrency/cancellation/deadline errors retain original contract constants and original causes. Hooks observe only; thrown errors and rejected promises are reported. Use host pipeline stages for intervention.
See USEGUIDE.en.md for batching, native SQL, vectors, COPY and replication.

Global `journal: { logger, namespace, binlogValues: true }` borrows the original logger's external binlog. PostgreSQL captures actual text/bytes/record/managed-vector changes and complete deadlines in the original transaction, appends only after actual COMMIT, and awaits the original append settlement. External append failures reach the host reporter and `onBinlogAppendError`; they cannot roll back committed data. External log and data commits are not atomic. When complete images are selected, native SQL/COPY/caller-owned vector tables reject before business queries or source pulls.

PostgreSQL storageLogStore uses indexExclusive:false and reads current journal state inside each original native transaction, without a cross-operation index. INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING bootstraps the head under the existing journal primary key, then SELECT FOR UPDATE serializes its read/write inside that transaction. No table, lifetime lock or renewal owner is added. nativeAtomic and original scope/terminal authority remain unchanged; 40001/40P01 use the existing physical retry path. When the same logger supplies external WAL, the original shared owner awaits the intent, then writes an independently named commit marker in the same PostgreSQL transaction. Actual commit precedes append/complete; failure retains both intent and marker for recovery on reopen. This marker shares the existing private table with short-lived lost-COMMIT evidence but has a separate identity, so normal transaction cleanup preserves recovery evidence. When the same logger selects external WAL and undoLog, the host projects `store.undo(txId, ctx?)`. The original builder locks every target, checks complete revisions and images, then restores text/bytes/record/vector/metadata and absolute deadlines in one actual PostgreSQL transaction; the new commit enters the same journal. Metadata journal identities round-trip through the original flat-key codec, while complete versions and private locks reuse the original revision and lock owners. ABA fails even when the current value matches. Original revision rows retain a native UUID birth and increasing version. dropOrg still deletes every target organization row; a recreated birth prevents old undo from reusing the same version. Adding the private column preserves existing values and versions; old external images without birth safely reject with UNDO_CONFLICT. Organization targets cannot restore one another. With the same logger selecting `level()` and `telemetry: true`, the original host observer records ordinary payloads, complete original errors, fixed organizations and canonical keys. Each complete retry loop emits once; scopes and private metadata do not duplicate entries. Disabled observation does not read level methods, and logging failures only report.

Every native commit writes its marker in the same transaction. A lost COMMIT acknowledgement is accepted only when that original marker is visible. Missing or unreadable evidence does not prove zero writes: the original physical controller seals, the original error chain survives, and no blind replay occurs. Known settlement removes the marker; cleanup failure reports and retains evidence.

Selected journals retain every actual native mutation in execution order, including repeated writes to one target and intermediate values. The original SQL RETURNING row supplies each exact raw after value and absolute deadline; no later read substitutes the final value. Undo keeps the host's existing first-before/final-after merge and complete final revision checks. Unselected operations keep their original SQL and native path.

Choose `/pg`, `/postgres-js`, or Bun 1.4.4+ `/bun` as shown in README. Pass the caller-owned driver to postgresBackendPlugin. Every store below comes from `host.backend('postgres')`; Features are selected explicitly on that same plugin.

Reads retain input order, duplicates and missing entries; duplicate write keys reject before I/O. Each array occupies one bound parameter. Omitted ttlMs preserves a live value's deadline and gives new values no deadline; zero means immediate expiry. Internal null array elements mean omitted durations, not client absolute timestamps. Each native update samples the database clock.

`host.org(validUuid).backend('postgres')` fixes an organization. Equal keys, TTL, locks, notifications and standard collections remain isolated; first access creates no tables. Selected vector/durableChangeFeed APIs publish through that child's original provider. Organization views reject caller-table native endpoints. Default root transactions may mix records and application SQL; callers supply tenant filters for raw SQL.

Use native SQL directly for application JSONB, full-text indexes, FOR UPDATE and pg_advisory_xact_lock. Standard records retain portable TEXT; shared query semantics process fields on the client over native bytea key ranges. int8 returns bigint, numeric/date/JSON/array retain native text, and bytea returns a copied Uint8Array. No global parser changes occur. postgres.js string parameters explicitly use TEXT to prevent its destination-OID JSON serialization; application SQL casts other types explicitly.

cosine/dot/euclid use `<=>`/`<#>`/`<->` with scores 1-distance/-distance/-distance. Native vector(d) stores float32, with its corresponding precision and tied-order limits. Create a logical collection once; other organizations may use collection('documents') with the shared physical configuration. `api.pgvector.search({table:['app_vectors'],idColumn:'id',vectorColumn:'embedding',payloadColumn:'payload'}, q, {metric:'cosine',limit:10,efSearch:64})` queries caller-owned tables. The module creates no ANN index.

Global collection configuration uses a stable private namespace identity in the original configuration table, independently of every host's default organization. Equal schema/prefix/name identities share one native table across hosts. dropOrg removes only that organization's point rows and retains global configuration, other organizations and native table structure. Expiry indexes also lead with org_id.

The application creates the target table. CSV defaults to header=false and comma; text defaults to TAB and rejects header. Only client STDIN is supported; files and PROGRAM are rejected. The sourceFactory creates a fresh iterable per actual attempt. Failures drain native COPY before rollback. Transactions have no listen method. Channels are nonempty UTF-8 names of at most 63 bytes; payloads are below 8000 bytes. Both reject NUL.

Deployment supplies wal_level=logical, a REPLICATION role, a persistent pgoutput slot and FOR ALL TABLES publication. Detection performs no deployment DDL. One commit aggregates bounded invalidations in each organization's first WAL occurrence order, without retaining business rows. Opaque cursors bind store/slot/org route, COMMIT commitEndLsn and the processed organization prefix. Partial progress never confirms that end; restart decodes from the original slot's unconfirmed position and skips the processed prefix. Only the final item permits subsequent after or successful tail acknowledgement. The peer uses auto:false, timeoutSeconds:0 and flowControl:true; row LSN/commitLsn are never checkpoints and positions are never incremented/decremented. One slot permits one active consumer.

Callback failure stops without confirming its commit. Disposal releases only the replication connection and leaves the slot/pool intact. A first empty read returns a complete cursor at the original native confirmed position. configuration.name: owner
configuration.description: PostgreSQL 的 storageLogStore 使用 indexExclusive:false，每操作在原生事务内读取当前日志，不保留跨操作索引。现有 journal 表主键通过 INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING 初始化缺失 head 行，随后 SELECT FOR UPDATE 在同一事务内串行读写；不增加表、资源期锁或续租器。nativeAtomic 与原 scope/terminal 保持，40001/40P01 仍走原物理重试。借用同一 logger 的外置 WAL 时，原共享 owner 先 await intent，再在同一 PG 事务写入独立命名的 commit marker；真实提交后 append/complete，失败保留 intent 与 marker，重开沿原 owner 恢复。此 marker 与 lost-COMMIT 短期证据复用同一私有表但身份不同，正常事务清理不会误删恢复证据。同一 logger 同时选择外置 WAL 与 undoLog 时，宿主才投影 `store.undo(txId, ctx?)`：原 builder 先锁定全部目标，复核完整修订与镜像，再在一个真实 PG 事务恢复 text/bytes/record/vector/metadata 与绝对期限；新提交仍进入原日志。metadata 的日志身份沿原 flat-key codec 往返，版本与私有键锁复用原 revisions/lock owner，ABA 即使值已恢复相同也拒绝。原修订行保存 native `birth` UUID 与递增 `version`；dropOrg 仍删除全部目标组织行，重建的新 birth 阻止旧 undo 复用同版本。已有私有修订表增列时保原值与版本，缺少 birth 的旧外置镜像以 `UNDO_CONFLICT` 安全拒绝。不同组织的日志不能互相恢复。选择 `level()` 的同一 logger 并设置 `telemetry: true` 时，原宿主观察器记录普通 payload、完整原错误、固定组织与规范键；原完整重试循环只发一条，scope 与私有 metadata 不重复记录。关闭该选项不读取 level 方法，日志失败只报告。
